Plot conditional predictions

Source: R/conditional-values.R
draw.conditional_values.Rd

Curves show predictions and intervals. Grouped numeric conditions show a surface, with predictions mapped to fill and, for surface = "3d", height. Remaining conditions create separate facets. Flat surfaces show estimates; ci_3d = TRUE adds the returned lower and upper interval surfaces in 3D.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'conditional_values'
draw(
  object,
  facet_scales = "fixed",
  discrete_colour = NULL,
  discrete_fill = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  ...,
  surface = c("raster", "tile", "3d"),
  surface_3d = list(),
  continuous_fill = NULL,
  contour = TRUE,
  n_contour = NULL,
  ci_3d = FALSE,
  zlab = NULL
)

Arguments

object

an object of class "conditional_values", the result of a call to conditional_values().

facet_scales

character; should facets have the same axis scales across facets? See ggplot2::facet_wrap() for details. Options are: "fixed" (default), "free_x", "free_y", and "free".

discrete_colour

a suitable colour scale to be used when plotting discrete variables.

discrete_fill

a suitable fill scale to be used when plotting discrete variables.

xlab

character; label for the x axis of the plot.

ylab

character; label for the prediction axis of a curve, or the second covariate axis of a surface.

...

additional arguments; currently unused.

surface

character; "raster" (default), "tile", or "3d". Applies to grouped numeric conditions. Three-dimensional surfaces require the optional ggcube package. Irregular flat grids use rectangles bounded by adjacent coordinate midpoints.

surface_3d

named list of view options passed to ggcube::coord_3d(), for example list(yaw = 45, persp = FALSE). The default view uses ggcube::light(backface_scale = 1). A supplied light replaces that lighting specification. The same view applies to all panels; gratia retains its plot theme.

continuous_fill

a suitable fill scale to be used when plotting continuous variables.

contour

logical; draw contour lines on surfaces? Defaults to TRUE.

n_contour

numeric; the number of contour bins. Will result in n_contour - 1 contour lines being drawn. See ggplot2::geom_contour().

ci_3d

logical; add the returned lower and upper interval surfaces when surface = "3d"? Defaults to FALSE.

zlab

character; label for the surface fill legend and 3D height axis. Defaults to the prediction label, or the difference and its scale for conditional differences.

Label layout

Pass label_control = draw_label_control(...) to draw() to wrap discrete axis labels and legend text, stagger discrete tick labels, or adjust legend and colour-bar layout. Settings apply to each panel, including unwrapped plot lists. See draw_label_control() for the available settings.
